nodes.name: discovery.py
nodes.summary: Builds the configured source list for discovery runs: converts SourceEntry config into concrete source objects (API, sitemap, RSS, direct page) and lists configured sources with guards against example entries.

nodes.name: _is_example
nodes.summary: Returns True for placeholder/example source entries.

nodes.name: _entry_value
nodes.summary: Reads a raw value from a source entry (config or env override).

nodes.name: build_sources
nodes.summary: Materializes the configured source list into concrete source objects of the right adapter kind.

nodes.name: list_configured_sources
nodes.summary: Lists configured sources with kind and guard flags for the CLI.

nodes.name: discovery_search.py
nodes.summary: Search-driven discovery for candidate jobs: DDGS web search, rate-limit pacing state machine, provider fallback, candidate URL collection, per-source provenance, and the run_planned_discovery orchestrator.

nodes.name: _first_term_for_source
nodes.summary: Picks the first focal location term applicable to a source.

nodes.name: _looks_throttled
nodes.summary: Detects throttling from an error/status.

nodes.name: build_global_queries
nodes.summary: Builds global (non-track) search queries from catalog hosts and focal locations.

nodes.name: fetch_candidate_jobs
nodes.summary: Runs a web search for candidates and returns fresh Job models.

nodes.name: run_planned_discovery
nodes.summary: Executes a full planned discovery run: paces sources, runs web searches and providers, dedupes, and returns persisted matches.

nodes.name: RateLimitExceeded
nodes.summary: Raised when a source is currently rate-limited.

nodes.name: SearchHit
nodes.summary: A search result hit (title, url, host, snippet).

nodes.name: WebSearchDiscovery
nodes.summary: DDGS-backed web search wrapper with per-query candidate URL extraction.

nodes.name: _SourcePaceState
nodes.summary: Internal per-source pacing state machine.

nodes.name: SourceRunStats
nodes.summary: Per-source discovery run statistics (requests, hits, jobs, latency).

nodes.name: DiscoveryPacingReport
nodes.summary: Aggregate pacing/yield report for a run with totals.

nodes.name: RateLimitPacer
nodes.summary: Rate-limit dodging state machine: enforces per-source wait budgets, swaps sources when throttled, tracks yields.

nodes.name: providers.py
nodes.summary: Native provider track augmenting search discovery: DiscoveryProvider ABC, JSON feed provider base (RemoteOK/Remotive), payload normalization helpers, and a registry/health facade with provider_for/provider_health_for.

nodes.name: _default_http
nodes.summary: Default httpx GET helper with timeout/headers.

nodes.name: _empty_location
nodes.summary: True when a location string is blank.

nodes.name: _strip_html
nodes.summary: Strips HTML tags from text via BeautifulSoup.

nodes.name: _parse_dt
nodes.summary: Parses flexible date formats (iso, epoch, strptime).

nodes.name: _parse_salary_text
nodes.summary: Parses salary text ranges (K notation, ranges) into numbers.

nodes.name: _matches_search
nodes.summary: Case-insensitive keyword match over title+tags.

nodes.name: provider_for
nodes.summary: Resolves the provider class for a catalog entry.

nodes.name: provider_health_for
nodes.summary: Builds provider health info from the latest run.

nodes.name: ProviderStatus
nodes.summary: Provider status enum.

nodes.name: ProviderHealth
nodes.summary: Health enum for provider last run.

nodes.name: ProviderError
nodes.summary: Provider fetch error base.

nodes.name: MalformedProviderPayload
nodes.summary: Raised on structurally invalid provider payloads.

nodes.name: ProviderResult
nodes.summary: Normalized provider result envelope (jobs, status, stats).

nodes.name: ProviderRunStats
nodes.summary: Provider run statistics record.

nodes.name: DiscoveryProvider
nodes.summary: Abstract base for discovery providers.

nodes.name: HttpFeedProvider
nodes.summary: Base for JSON HTTP feed providers.

nodes.name: RemoteOkProvider
nodes.summary: RemoteOK API provider.

nodes.name: RemotiveProvider
nodes.summary: Remotive API provider with currency + search filters.

nodes.name: sitemap.py
nodes.summary: XML sitemap job source: fetches and parses a sitemap, turning job-page URLs into DirectPageSource fetches, plus a light log_event wrapper for testability.

nodes.name: log_event
nodes.summary: Thin event-log wrapper.

nodes.name: SitemapJobSource
nodes.summary: XML sitemap job source: fetch + parse loc URLs into direct page fetches.

nodes.name: DirectPageSourceProxy
nodes.summary: Proxy that fetches each sitemap URL via DirectPageSource.

nodes.name: sources.py
nodes.summary: Source taxonomy and adapters: Source ABC, API/ATS/RSS/structured/mcp/browser source kinds, plus concrete Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby/SmartRecruiters/Workable/direct-page/RSS-JSON adapters with HTML/date/number/location parsing helpers.

nodes.name: _html
nodes.summary: Strips HTML tags from a source value.

nodes.name: _dt
nodes.summary: Flexible datetime parse for source payloads.

nodes.name: _num

nodes.name: _sr_loc
nodes.summary: SmartRecruiters location normalization.

nodes.name: SourceError
